item.title: Investing in the future: International Paper’s $250M project is good news for Dallas County
item.description: International Paper’s Riverdale Mill is making a $250 million investment that will change the future of Selma’s largest employer and fully align the site with the company’s focus on packaging.

item.title: Brenda Tuck returns to lead Selma and Dallas County Economic Development Authority
item.description: When Brenda Tuck stepped into her new role as executive director of the Selma and Dallas County Economic Development Authority in January, it marked both a professional milestone and a homecoming.

item.title: Magic City Expo Conference Alabama: Complete Attendee Guide
item.description: Magic City Expo is a one-day business exhibition and community event held in Birmingham, Alabama.

item.title: Local leaders proclaim Glaucoma Awareness Month as dozens get free eye care
item.description: On Thursday, Jan. 29, Visually Impaired People Organization, Inc. (V.I.P) partnered with Selma’s Primary Eye Care to offer free glaucoma eye screenings in honor of January being Glaucoma Awareness Month.

item.title: Naugher’s clutch fourth quarter lifts Montevallo boys past Selma in area win
item.description: With momentum swinging and pressure mounting in the fourth quarter, Nahjear Naugher delivered when it mattered most.

item.title: Selma’s pressure overwhelms Montevallo in area loss
item.description: Defensive pressure and athleticism proved to be the difference in a girls basketball matchup on Friday night, as the Selma Saints pulled away from the Montevallo Bulldogs for a 54-30 area win at Montevallo High School on Jan. 23.

item.title: Training the next generation: School districts providing a pathway to success for career tech students
item.description: As Alabama faces a growing demand for skilled workers, Selma City Schools (SCS) and Dallas County School District (DCSD) are investing in career technical education, turning classrooms into training grounds that resemble industry floors.

item.title: Forged in Selma: Antonio Brown's welding journey inspires his students to dream big
item.description: Life has come full circle for Antonio Brown. A Southside High School graduate who first picked up a welding torch at age 12, Brown has built a career that carried him across the country and back home, where he is now shaping the next generation of welders.

item.title: Senior night ends in sweep as Maplesville tops Ellwood Christian in area action
item.description: Ellwood Christian Academy honored its seniors on Wednesday night, Jan. 28, as the Eagles hosted the Maplesville High School Red Devils in a Class 1A area matchup on their home court.

item.title: Panthers shine on senior night as Southside earns gritty win over J.F. Shields
item.description: Southside High honored its seniors in front of a home crowd on Thursday, January 29, 2026, as the Panthers hosted J.F. Shields High School in an exciting varsity doubleheader on senior night.
